q: A fetch is aborted and an AbortError surfaces inside the wrapper. What name does the skill check first, what status is stamped on the error, and is the abort wrapped in a new RequestError or rethrown as-is?
Undici raises TypeError with the network reason hidden in cause. How does the skill unwrap cause when it is an Error versus a string, and what error class carries status 500?
A 204 or 205 arrives and a HEAD request succeeds. What does the wrapper return at once for 204 or 205, and what does it return for a HEAD under 400?
A conditional request comes back 304. What does the wrapper read first, what message does the thrown error carry, and which helper read the body?
A failed response needs a message built. Which helper builds it, what suffix does an object message gain, and what yields Unknown error?
The wrapper must pick a body reader. What does it do for application/json, and what does it return for a type that is neither text nor JSON?
A request goes out through endpoint defaults. When does the skill call fetchWrapper directly on endpoint.parse output, and when does it hand the closure to hook instead?
An upload needs its stream option and the server flags a sunset. Which option carries the abort signal, when is duplex half set, and which header drives the deprecation warning?
You replay the abort check with rg over fetch-wrapper.ts. Which two numbered lines match AbortError, and what comparison sits on line 58?
You list every file that mentions fetchWrapper. Which two source files come back, and which wrapper name did you search?
